title: Prayer before confession
text: Holy Spirit, giver of grace, enlighten my soul with heavenly light, that I may know all my sins, their number and their circumstances. Drive out every darkness of my heart, that I may know myself rightly and not deceive myself by frivolous excuses. Move my will also, that I may heartily repent of my sins, sincerely confess them, make satisfaction for them and truly amend my life. Amen. Alleluia. Our Father. Hail Mary.
